response:
I am so incredibly sorry for the loss of your mom. Losing a parent is one of the most profound and painful experiences, and it is completely normal to feel overwhelmed, lost, or a mix of many different emotions right now. Please know that there is no "right" timeline or way to grieve. It is a deeply personal journey, and it is okay to just take things one day, or even one hour, at a time.

As you navigate this heavy time, try to be as gentle with yourself as possible. Allow yourself to feel whatever comes up without judgment, and lean on trusted friends or family members who can listen. You might also find comfort in honoring her memory in small ways, like writing her a letter or doing something she loved. If the grief ever feels too heavy to carry alone, reaching out to a grief counselor or a support group can provide a safe, understanding space to process your feelings.
